title: ​​Gnana Shekinah Nanneti​ (Radiographer) — Interim Order Application
text:
Order:
ORDER: The Registrar is directed to suspend the registration of Mrs Gnana Shekinah Nanneti on an interim basis for a period of 12 months.

Notes:
This Order will be reviewed by the Committee no later than 11 June 2026, or earlier if new evidence which is relevant to the Order becomes available after it was made.
court: Health and Care Professions Tribunal Service
